name: b-code-website
description: B-Code company website — public site, admin dashboard, and API

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix admin
scripts.start:prod: npm run build && npm run start:prod --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix admin
